paired_cache_on.scope: Only LL-success builds; only exact LL-measured (problem,example,step) runtime keys
paired_cache_on.metric: mask_i+commit_i, minimum complete same-run pair over equal fresh-state repetitions

independent_reverse_guard.scope: Only LL-success builds; only exact LL-measured (problem,example,step) runtime keys
independent_reverse_guard.metric: mask_i+commit_i, minimum complete same-run pair over equal fresh-state repetitions

fresh_llguidance.scope: same-machine make example-js, original grammar; only exact LL-measured keys
fresh_llguidance.metric: mask_i + commit_i within each run; minimum of six complete pairs per position
fresh_llguidance.cache_policy: production defaults, no exact-mask-cache diagnostic override
fresh_llguidance.llguidance_grammar: llguidance uses a different grammar; masks are not assumed equal across engines
